prompts.label: Research & Insight (Elite)
prompts.prefix: You are a senior {discipline} expert. For a {audience} audience at a {reading_level} reading level and {tone} tone, extract exactly {num_insights} non-obvious insights, each with: why it matters, supporting evidence from the transcript (quote/snippet), and a concrete application example. Then synthesize patterns and implications.
prompts.suffix: Output sections (use these exact headers): 1) Key Insights (1–{num_insights}), 2) Frameworks/Models (named + how to apply), 3) Risks & Counterarguments, 4) Assumptions & Open Questions, 5) {plan_horizon}-Day Action Plan (phased). Constraints: do not invent stats; if data is missing, write “TBD”.

prompts.label: Action Plan (30/60/90)
prompts.prefix: Turn the content into a practical plan grouped by 30/60/90 days with {quick_wins} quick wins in Week 1. Use {risk_tolerance} risk posture. Assume default owner role is {owner_role}.
prompts.suffix: Return 3 parts: A) Milestones (table with columns: Phase(30/60/90), Milestone, Success KPI, Owner, Start, Due, Effort(S/M/L→hrs), Impact(1–5), Dependencies, Risk, Notes); B) Week-1 Quick Wins (≤{quick_wins}); C) Risks & Mitigations. Do not invent facts—mark missing items as TBD.

prompts.label: Persona Rewrite (Variants)
prompts.prefix: Rewrite the key takeaways for a {persona} audience on {platform} in ~{words} words at {reading_level} level with a {tone} tone. Preserve quotes and numbers; do not add claims.
prompts.suffix: Output: Variant A, Variant B, Variant C. For each: Title (≤60 chars), Body (~{words} words), Single CTA, 5 hashtags (if platform ≠ Email). If “Banned Phrases” supplied, avoid them. End with a 1-line TL;DR.

prompts.label: Score & Improve (Weighted)
prompts.prefix: Score the transcript on a 1–100 weighted scale across: clarity, evidence, actionability, originality, brand_safety. Use the provided weights.
prompts.suffix: Return sections: 1) Weights & Scores (table: Dimension | Weight | Score | Rationale | Example), include Weighted Overall and formula; 2) Top 10 Flaws (Severity H/M/L, Fix Effort S/M/L); 3) Fix Plan ordered by ROI; 4) Missing Info to Reach 100 (bullet questions); 5) Before/After (rewrite one weak paragraph).

prompts.label: Viral Clip Extractor (Elite)
prompts.prefix: Identify {num_hooks} timestamped hook moments optimized for {platforms}. Prioritize concrete numbers, contrarian claims, and emotion triggers. Respect each platform’s max length.
prompts.suffix: Return a table with columns: Start (mm:ss), End (mm:ss), Hook (2 words), Opening Line (<1s), On-screen Text (≤6 words), Angle, B-roll/Overlay, Caption (≤100 chars), CTA, Brand-Safety Flags, Safe Alt Phrasing. End with 3 thumbnail text ideas.

prompts.label: Business Model Breakdown
prompts.prefix: Extract and formalize the business model for a {biz_type} context. If numbers are missing, state assumptions at the top with {numbers_confidence} confidence.
prompts.suffix: Return sections: 1) Revenue Streams (table: Stream | Driver | Price | Volume Assumption | Sensitivities), 2) Cost Structure (Fixed/Variable, % of revenue), 3) Unit Economics (table: CAC, Payback, Gross Margin, LTV with formulas), 4) Moats & Risks, 5) Top 3 Optimization Plays with expected impact.

prompts.label: SOP / How-To (Bulletproof)
prompts.prefix: Convert into an SOP suitable for a {role} to execute. Include guardrails and checks.
prompts.suffix: Output: 1) Procedure (numbered, each step with Why/Inputs/Action/Expected Output/Owner/Time), 2) Quality Checklist, 3) Common Failure Modes & Fixes, 4) Tooling & Templates (links if present; else TBD). Keep reading level {reading_level}.

prompts.label: Content Calendar (30 Days)
prompts.prefix: Create a {days}-day cross-platform calendar using the chosen content pillars. Brand voice: {voice}.
prompts.suffix: Return a table: Date, Platform, Pillar, Post Idea, Hook, Format (clip/thread/carousel/live), Asset Needed, CTA, Hashtags, Success Metric. Also output a 5-post ‘starter pack’ (fully written).

prompts.label: Counterarguments & Steelman
prompts.prefix: Steelman the strongest opposing view to: {viewpoint}. Then reconcile with the transcript’s position.
prompts.suffix: Output sections: 1) Opposing Case (best version), 2) Evidence For/Against (table), 3) Reconciled View (conditions when each is right), 4) Decision Matrix (When to choose A vs B). Neutral tone; no straw-men.

prompts.label: Executive Summary (Bullets + Pull-quotes)
prompts.prefix: Summarize for a busy {audience} in ~{length} words with {tone} tone. Surface decisions and numbers first.
prompts.suffix: Return: 1) One-paragraph summary (~{length} words), 2) 5 Key Bullets (facts/decisions only), 3) 3 Pull-quotes, 4) 3 Tweet-length lines (≤280 chars). No fluff.

prompts.label: Repurpose: Thread/Carousel/Email
prompts.prefix: Repurpose into 3 formats tuned to the chosen platform. Preserve core claims and numbers; add examples if missing (mark as examples).
prompts.suffix: Return: A) Twitter/X Thread (8–12 tweets, numbered, strong hook tweet), B) LinkedIn Carousel outline (10 slides: slide title + 1-2 bullets), C) Email (subject, preview line, body with scannable subheads, single CTA).
